name: What's the difference between photos I take and photos a roofer takes?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between photos I take and photos a roofer takes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The photos you take serve as initial documentation and personal records of the damage. A professional roofer, like those at Discounted Roofing Co., will provide a more detailed and specialized set of photos. Their documentation often includes specific angles, close-ups of technical damage, and detailed annotations that are crucial for precise repair assessments and insurance negotiations. Our photos are often part of a comprehensive inspection report.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your photos are initial records; a roofer's photos offer detailed, specialized, and annotated documentation for precise assessments and insurance.
